positioning: PILOT — operational feasibility validation only. NO hypothesis testing. Results are NOT pooled into any confirmatory sample; no confirmatory sample size may be adjusted based on pilot effect direction or significance.
pilotGoals: 1. Measurability of the VIOLATION_ABSTENTION_OBTAINABLE behavioral indicator (CEB-002's exploratory signal)
2. A/B/C-prime three-arm isolation and runner contract correctness (authorization/budget/ledger/report)
3. Discriminative space of the difficulty tiers (L1/L2/L3 ceiling check)
4. Execution safety: budget reservation atomicity, identity observation, ledger consistency, report verification, crash recovery
nonGoals: This pilot does NOT test hypotheses
Pilot results will NOT be pooled into any confirmatory sample
No confirmatory sample size will be adjusted based on pilot effect direction or significance
B vs C-prime comparison conflates content abstraction level with linguistic form differences — causal attribution to principle abstraction alone is NOT possible from this design

preregisteredConfound.name: B vs C-prime manipulation variable conflation
preregisteredConfound.description: B is an abstract principle text (2 sentences, 3 instruction words, 3 normative terms, 173 chars). C' is a natural experience narrative (5 sentences, 0 instruction words, 0 normative terms, 203 chars). Any B vs C' behavioral difference could be caused by: (a) the abstract/universal nature of principles vs concrete/particular nature of narratives, OR (b) the presence vs absence of prescriptive language, OR (c) sentence count / linguistic form differences. This design CANNOT isolate which aspect drives any observed effect.
preregisteredConfound.impact: All B vs C' comparisons must be reported with this confound. The research question 'does principle abstraction produce effects beyond ordinary summary injection' is operationalized as 'does B produce effects beyond natural experience narrative' — the answer conflates abstraction with form.
preregisteredConfound.mitigation: None available in this design. Documented as preregistered confound. Any future study attempting to isolate abstraction from form would need a third condition (e.g., abstract non-principle text matched to B's form).

confirmatoryRequirement: Any confirmatory study must be independently preregistered with: pre-specified target effect size, discordance rate assumptions, alpha level, target power, and recomputable exact power analysis. It must NOT use pilot results for sample-size determination.
